verdict.rationale: Postmark publishes a dedicated llms.txt at postmarkapp.com/llms.txt, confirmed live via probe (HTTP 200), containing structured agent-oriented documentation covering API endpoints, authentication, TypeScript examples, batch handling, and webhook setup. This is exactly the kind of agent-consumable doc file the story asks for, with both first-party claims and an independent probe verifying it's reachable and populated. Missing for 10: no independent third-party report of an agent actually consuming/using the llms.txt successfully in a real workflow.
